notes.title: Update - Final Stretch Update (Release date Sept 22!)
notes.content:
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-7-header_x2.png

Road to Dog Sled Saga 1.0
September is a huge month for us - we'll be in the Indie MEGABOOTH at Pax West Sept. 4th & 5th, and in the inaugural Google Indie Games Festival Sept. 24th!

This is the seventh and final in a string updates themed around major changes to the game. On September 22nd, 2016, we're releasing the 1.0 version of Dog Sled Saga to Steam, Google Play, and the Apple App Store!

http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/release-date-update-social-x2-1.png

View this update on our website

Previously:
 5) Star & Support Update
 5) Employee Update
 4) Informed Decisions Update
 3) Sponsorship Update
 2) Operating Cost Update
 1) Dog Dynamics Update

Changes
The release date is the big news, but this final update has got some tricks up its sleeve as well.

New Options Menu

Added resolution selection
Gamepad remapping

New save file system
Multiple save file switching
Steam Cloud Support
Dog Petting
 Petting Favorite Thing type added (or you can just do it to be nice)http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/petting_x2-1.gif
Music cycling in menus
Software OpenGL rendering allowed
 May allow the game to run on certain problematic hardware
Various polish and fixes
 
What's coming in 1.0?
Lots of new features are already completed for the full release, plus a few that are still coming together...
Breeding
 Train your new teammates from the day they're born - influence their unique traits to be just what you need!
 http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-7-breeding-1.png
New Scenes
Embarkment Lodge - the go-to tourist hub for Mount St. Something
 http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/screen3.png
Monument to Aurora - an age-old statue honoring the subject of Mount St. Something's favorite campfire story
 http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/monument-to-aurora.png
Rival (and other story elements)
 
Look out for this jerk on the trails...
 http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-7-rival.png]
 
The future
Version 1.0 won't be the last you'll hear of Dog Sled Saga! There are a number of ideas we had during our Kickstarter campaign that we would still like to develop as major post-release updates to the game.

 

We hope you're as excited as we are for the final release!
 Let us know in the comments, forums, Twitter, or Facebook if you have any feedback on this update.

-  Dan and Lisa

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/dan-and-lisa.png

notes.title: Update July 23rd, 2016 - Star & Support Update
notes.content:
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-6-header-alt_x2-1.png

Road to Dog Sled Saga 1.0
This is the sixth of several upcoming updates themed around major changes to the game. We've mapped out the rest of the game's development looking towards exiting Early Access and releasing our mobile versions. We'd love your feedback as we go! Keep your eyes open for the rest of the final stretch.

View this update on our website

Previously:
 5) Employee Update
 4) Informed Decisions Update
 3) Sponsorship Update
 2) Operating Cost Update
 1) Dog Dynamics Update

Changes
We've always felt that some skills, especially those that provide a speed boost, overpower all of the other ones. We enacted a long-planned change to help bolster the other skills. Introducing Star & Support skill classes! Also introducing the German Shepherd breed!
Skill Classhttp://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/dog-skill-star-icon_x3.png Star skills only apply to the dog whose skill triggersStar skills include: Speed Boost, Competitive, Charge Up, Block Speed Drophttp://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/dog-skill-support-icon_x3.png Support skills apply their effect to all dogs on the team for the duration of their dog's skill triggerSupport skills include: Light Eater, Good Catch, Tangle FreeGerman Shepherd breed added

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7296891/4e4f95aa5a992f840e10bb3b183f55564acedce8.gif
Journal screen reworkedUnified Journal and Mentor screen with mode switchingImprove navigation UIAdded journal entries per dog breedFixed a few journal prompt triggersEdited some journal entries and promptVarious other fixes and improvements
 
This looks to be the last or second to last of these updates before the final release!
 Let us know in the comments, forums, Twitter, or Facebook if you have any feedback on this update.

-  Dan and Lisa

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/dan-and-lisa.png

notes.title: Update June 17th, 2016 - Employee Update
notes.content:
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-5-header_x2.png

Road to Dog Sled Saga 1.0
This is the fifth of several upcoming updates themed around major changes to the game. We've mapped out the rest of the game's development looking towards exiting Early Access and releasing our mobile versions. We'd love your feedback as we go! Keep your eyes open for the rest of the final stretch.

View this update on our website

Previously:
4) Informed Decisions Update
3) Sponsorship Update
2) Operating Cost Update
1) Dog Dynamics Update


Changes
Ever feel like you can't keep all your growing kennel of dogs practiced and rested? Now you can hire one or two extra pairs of hands! Employees can let you multitask (or just regimen more dogs,) and some of them have perks to do tasks better than you can. You'll have to pay for employees on hire and with your monthly expenses.


http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/employees.gif

EmployeesCan hire employees for additional regimen capacity1 employee slot after reaching League 32 employee slots after reaching League 6
Employee perks increase Caretaking and Training effectiveness at additional monthly costLvl 1 perks available in League 4 or higherLvl 2 perks available in League 5 or higher
 

http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/employee-hire.gif

 

Behind the scenes - Preliminary Localization support

Reworked external strings
Partially removed existing hardcoded strings



Various bug fixes and improvements

 

http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/employee-regimen.gif




This is a smaller update post than the past few, but we're excited to release a nice new management feature and cool employee art that's been queued up for a while!
 Let us know in the comments, forums, Twitter, or Facebook if you have any feedback on this update.

-  Dan and Lisa

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/dan-and-lisa.png

notes.title: Update May 24th, 2016 - Informed Decisions Update
notes.content:
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/header-852-480-1.png

Road to Dog Sled Saga 1.0
This is the fourth of several upcoming updates themed around major changes to the game. We've mapped out the rest of the game's development looking towards exiting Early Access and releasing our mobile versions. We'd love your feedback as we go! Keep your eyes open for the rest of the final stretch.

View this update on our website

Previously:
3) Sponsorship Update
2) Operating Cost Update
1) Dog Dynamics Update


Major changes
This update is all about giving you better information about your team before you make decisions, and after the consequences of your decisions have occurred. We don't want you to need to jump in and out of different menu screens to answer the questions you might have about your situation in the game.

Kennel Screen menu flow
Fewer resets of kennel screen (when you leave and come back it will be as you left it)Pre-race screen changesNew topic boxes on dog columnsGroup scrolling for easy comparisonExtra info popups upon clicking topic boxesAccess to full dog detail cards by clicking a dog's nameSwap in off-duty dogs by clicking the top of a dog card, instead of backing out of the screenImproved polish and animations

http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/pre-race_x2.gif

 
Post-race screenShows stat changes resulting from a race for each dogAnimations per dog followed by overview array
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/post-race_x2.gif

 
Skill triggering reworkedFixed some mistakes in the skill system so they trigger at the intended frequency per skill levelLighting technical changesShould improve loading times between some screensAllows for real time lighting scheme changes (coming soon!)Improved loading timesLoading time at launch greatly reducedLoading on lighting scheme changes reduced (see above)Minor bug fixes and improvements
 
 

While this update is about improving and clarifying what's already in the game, the next ones are going to be more about new features. Keep an eye out! Let us know in the comments, forums, Twitter, or Facebook if you have any feedback on this update.

- Dan and Lisa

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/dan-and-lisa.png

notes.title: Update March 28th, 2016 - Sponsorship Update
notes.content:
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-3-header_x2.png

 
Road to Dog Sled Saga 1.0
This is the third of several upcoming updates themed around major changes to the game. We've mapped out the rest of the game's development looking towards exiting Early Access and releasing our mobile versions. We'd love your feedback as we go! Keep your eyes open for the rest of the final stretch.

View this update on our website

Previously:
2) Operating Cost Update
1) Dog Dynamics Update

 
Major changes
We've greatly changed the way sponsorships are offered to you and the rewards you'll get from them. Gone is the array of unceremonious, confusing checkboxes!

Sponsorship offers
Any sponsor upgrades you had in an existing save will be removed in this update, but hang tight...
Sponsors may now approach you every 5 to 10 days to offer you a specific sponsorship upgrade according to the cumulative Fame level of your team.
Sponsorships come in 3 types: Standard, Major, and Exclusive. You have 3 slots for sponsorships, and the types take 1, 2, or 3 slots, respectively.More fame will get you better upgrades as a lesser sponsorship type (fewer slots required).

http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/sponsor-manage_x2.gif

Sponsor upgrades
Effects:
Foodbag upgrade slot count reduced from 6 / 7 / 8 / 10 / 12 to 6 / 7 / 8 / 9 / 10 slots by level of upgrade.
Sled upgrade now reduces sled friction by 1 Snow Quality level per level of upgrade. Friction influence on acceleration/deceleration has been tweaked.
Rope upgrade now reduces the count of recent rope snags by 1 per level of upgrade, effectively delaying tangles by a snag.
Funding upgrade now reduces total monthly expenses by 5 / 10 / 15 / 20 %  by level of upgrade.

Visuals:
Unique sled body per Sled Upgrade level
Company logos for sledpack according to Funding Upgrade

http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/sled-variety_x4.gif
Various sled upgrades, funding logos, and sledpack colors!


Fame
Fame no longer compounds based on existing fame level prior to a race
Fame level thresholds have been lowered
Some fame is granted to all dogs in a 1st place finish


Color customization
Dog harness color, which was previously randomized at hire, is now customizable.
Sledpack color is also customizable

http://i.giphy.com/3osxYchKZjwfdQKZ4A.gif
 
UI updates
Revised notification system - notification instances (e.g. "Race Today" popup in the Kennel Screen) will not be repeated in a single play session
Fame level and breed added to dog cards
Other small tweaks

 
Technical: New bundled Java runtime
The game will no longer prefer your installed JRE over the bundled one
Executable files changed on all platforms
Windows 64 bit users will now use a 64 bit JRE
Let us know if these changes affect your ability to play the game!

 

Have fun trying to score the best sponsorship configuration for your team!
 Let us know in the comments, forums, Twitter or Facebook if you have any feedback on this update.

- Lisa & Dan

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/dan-and-lisa.png

notes.title: Update February 19th, 2016 - Operating Cost Update
notes.content:
http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/update-2-header-1.png


Road to Dog Sled Saga 1.0
This is the second of several upcoming updates themed around major changes to the game. We've mapped out the rest of the game's development looking towards exiting Early Access and releasing our mobile versions. We'd love your feedback as we go! Keep your eyes open for the rest of the final stretch. 
View this update on our website

Previously:
1) Dog Dynamics Update


Major changes 
This update is all about changing the way money works in Dog Sled Saga, and making it so mushers must be more selective with the dogs on their team.


Operating cost
In addition to league dues, the Dog & Driver Association now charges a registration fee per dog on your team. You might need to make some cuts… The game will walk you through adapting to these changes.

 http://i.giphy.com/26FPAEHtLrZH3FeXS.gif

If you take dogs off your team, you can rehire them in the future. Some of their progress will be lost, though.
Also, you’ll need to build expansions on your kennel if you need more slots for dogs! A big one-time cost.http://www.dogsledsaga.com/news/assets/kennel-expasion-tarp_x1.png


Regimen system
Choose whether each dog will or won’t do the day’s task with you or get rest while idle in the kennel

http://i.giphy.com/26FPpUy2Xt8ioPH4Q.gif



Better error handling
We’re happy that Dog Sled Saga’s Early Access experience has been smooth for many of you, but game development gets inevitably messy sometimes - our game has been known to crash here and there with some of our builds!
Now, instead of abruptly closing, you should get an error popup, and a crash report will automatically be sent to Dan, the programmer. This should take a few steps out of the troubleshooting process we’ve used up to this point.



Difficulty balance
Fault chance has been altered/reduced for the various Happiness levels
Skill chance has also been altered/reduced
Skill level can no longer go beneath your skill cap minus one
Hunger rate has been reduced for races with 4 and 5 dogs
Fixed aptitudes showing before Specialty Lvl 1 is reached for dogs
Costs adjusted to accommodate new expenses
Overall difficulty curve reduction



Miscellaneous UI changes
Dog delta popups occur at the beginning of the next day without blocking actions
Dog delta popups for Skill Cap Up and Fatigue Capacity Up
Major kennel screen overhaul!
Tons more




We hope you like the new changes, and the next big update should be around the corner!

-  Dan and Lisa

notes.content:

Major changes

Dog dynamics overhaul
We've made some changes to the ups and downs that your dogs will experience over the course of their career. Many stats have been altered to make managing your team more challenging and interesting.


Fatigue

Dogs gain fatigue with each speed drop during a race
Light fatigue wears off quickly with rest
Deep fatigue gained if all light fatigue slots filled
Deep fatigue lingers longer and affects dogs' happiness
Fatigue capacity increases with perfect catches


http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/fatigue.gif


Happiness

Stepwise only - no longer a sliding scale
Neutral happiness is "good," with upward and downward modifiers
Recent Favorite Thing gives happiness up
Different amounts of deep fatigue give happiness down
No more happiness cap mechanic


Skill

Skill warm-up goes up and down rapidly
Gives increased chance of Skill triggering during races
Warm up by training on off-days leading up to races
Training while at max warm-up will increase skill cap
Resting reduces warmed-up status


http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/skill-bar.gif



Off-day tasks
Instead of only waiting for the next race, you now must choose what to do with your dogs on off-days.

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/day-task-image-layout.png
Currently, you may train or give care to as many of your dogs as you'd like per day. In a future update, you will be more limited, but you will be able to hire additional employees to help you...



Perfect catch changes
Perfectly timed catches are even more valuable now! Effects:

Increased skill trigger chance in race
Brief speed boost
Progress towards increasing fatigue capacity
Naturally makes your food supply go further

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/perfect-catch.gif



New dog breed - Samoyed
Another long-awaited sled-pulling dog added to the roster! Even fluffier than our Malamute, but with a smaller frame beneath the fur. Hire one for your team!
http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/portrait-frame-samoyed_x3.png



Thank you!
We can't say enough thanks to our players for checking out Dog Sled Saga. Your support and feedback are what pull us along the trail towards release. The game will be progressing fast now. Many elements that had not yet met our hopes for the games quality are coming together great in our eyes, and we hope it's a more fun, compelling game for you, too. Thanks for sticking with us!

- Dan & Lisa

http://dogsledsaga.com/dog-dynamics-update/img/dan-and-lisa.png

notes.title: Update October 10, 2015 - Fix crashes related to certain skills, improved fullscreen support, updated backend frameworks
notes.content:
If you've been unable to start the game
Give it another try - might just work now! Otherwise, please check your launch options and try the following:

Right click Dog Sled Saga in your Steam Library and choose "Properties"
In the "General" tab, click "Set Launch Options"
Type "-w" (for windowed) OR "-b" (for borderless windowed fullscreen) and hit ok
Close the window and try running the game


If the game has been crashing in the middle of races
I fixed an issue in the last build (long standing, now!) that will resolve that issue.

It has been a long time since we updated, but the project is picking up steam again! I experienced a long period of burnout that led to a fun side-project (FireWhip for iOS and Android) but also, unfortunately, an unproductive couple of months. Back on the horse, now - lots of substantial updates queued up!

Additionally, happy birthday to half of the Dog Sled Saga team - Lisa!

notes.title: Update March 15, 2015 - Rope and drag arrow animations, Windows JRE fallback fix
notes.content:
Small but important update - the "Main class not found" error that some users were getting when launching the game should be fixed.


    Min JRE version set to 1.7.0 in Windows executable.
    Red outline rope animation on snag and tangle
    Drag arrows outline flash on drag command


The issue was that we recently had to remove JRE6 compatibility from Dog Sled Saga, but I forgot to tell our executable. The game comes with a bundled JRE which will be used as a fallback if you don't have a compatible JRE installed on your system. The executable will no longer erroneously see JRE6 as a satisfactory JRE.

Moved save directory according to platform (existing saves will be relocated automatically)

Mac - %home folder% / Saved Games / Dog Sled Saga
Linux - %home folder% / .dogsledsaga


Thanks,
Dan and Lisa
